newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia achieved record cereal harvest in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia achieved record cereal harvest in 1995.

text.p: Ethiopia, trying to improve its drought and war-ravaged economy, harvested a record 8.7 million tonnes of cereals in 1995, a cabinet minister said.

"Ethiopia has achieved encouraging results in its policy of national food self-sufficiency -- in 1995 cereal output was a record 8.7 million tonnes," Agriculture Minister Teketel Forsido said in a statement at the weekend.
"The harvest is unprecedented in the economic history of this Horn of Africa country," the minister added.

Teketel hoped that Ethiopia would significantly reduce hunger and malnutrition in its population of 55 million in the forseeable future. But he called for help from global donors in order to fully meet this goal.

The 1995 production follows on improvements started in 1992 when Ethiopia recorded a 7.9 million-tonne cereals harvest. The minister gave no forecasts for 1996 but said conditions pointed to further improvement.
